title: Lakehouses and the medallion layers
objectives: Say what a Fabric lakehouse holds: Delta tables and files in OneLake
Tell what belongs in Bronze, Silver and Gold
Turn raw Bronze rows into typed Silver rows, one per key, latest load first

exercises.prompt: Write the SELECT that Silver's orders come from: order_id as INTEGER, order_date as DATE, amount as DECIMAL(12,2) and status in lower case, one row per order (its latest load), smallest order_id first.
hints: Order 1002 was loaded twice. Which load's row should Silver keep?
row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) numbers each order's loads, newest first. Keep number 1.
CAST each column to its type, and lower(status) so 'Complete' and 'complete' are the same status.
